leads.headline: COP31 ENDS WITH NO CLIMATE DEAL
leads.summary: After 48 hours of overtime talks, nearly 200 countries left the UN climate summit in Türkiye with no overarching agreement. The EU and others refused any deal that did not name a phase-out of fossil fuels.

leads.headline: DEMOCRATS CLINCH 258 HOUSE SEATS
leads.summary: Democrats secured at least 258 seats in the US House of Representatives, the largest majority for either party since 1992, after the last undecided races were called, a net gain of 44 seats.

leads.headline: RUSSIAN STRIKES KILL 11 NEAR KYIV
leads.summary: A Russian drone hit a five-storey apartment block in Dymer, in the Kyiv region. Rescuers pulled a boy aged 7 alive from the rubble; a strike on a supermarket in Vyshneve killed two more people.
